# glpi_software_license (Data Source)

Look up a GLPI software license.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "glpi_software_license" "by_name" {
  name = "example"
}

data "glpi_software_license" "by_id" {
  id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID. Set id or name.
- `name` (String) Name of the item. Set id or name; must match exactly one item.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `expire` (String) Expiration date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `location_id` (Number) ID of the location.
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) ID of the publisher.
- `number` (Number) Number of installations the license covers. -1 means unlimited.
- `otherserial` (String) Inventory number.
- `purchased_version_id` (Number) ID of the purchased software version.
- `serial` (String) License serial number.
- `software_id` (Number) ID of the software.
- `state_id` (Number) ID of the status.
- `type_id` (Number) ID of the license type.
- `used_version_id` (Number) ID of the software version in use.
- `valid` (Boolean) Whether the license is valid, computed by GLPI.
